pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal regions with medium-to-sharp edge gradients. Geometries on the flank are predominantly pentagonal and hexagonal with variable spatial areas, while patches toward the cranial region are more elongated and sub-rectangular.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous graph of light-colored interstitial spaces. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with slight narrowing toward the ventral area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude 1D geometric silhouette against the sky. The contour shows consistent pixel density along the dorsal line from the mid-neck to the shoulder.
